title: Anthropic PBC
description:
Anthropic PBC is a working paper offering a governance-focused counterpoint to Anthropic's 2026 Public Benefit Report, read alongside its S-1 and Constitution. It describes a verifiable-claims approach and a protocol for attributed endorsements and disputes, presented for public contest.

This record archives edition v0, published 3 November 2026: the paper markdown, its rendered HTML, the attestation protocol, and the risk-governance index. The associated GitHub repository may contain later work that is not part of this archived edition.

Verification scope: byte-exact quotation checks establish that text occurs in a source; they do not, by themselves, establish that every claim is supported, that an interpretation is correct, or that a governance or ethical conclusion is true. The attestation protocol describes how endorsements and disputes may be recorded; its inclusion does not imply that a person has endorsed the paper.

For this exact edition, cite 10.5281/zenodo.23928296. The version-family DOI is 10.5281/zenodo.23928295. Repository and ongoing work: github.com/srvo/anthropic-pbc.
